raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingest 2026-01-17) stores txn_ts as epoch milliseconds in a VARCHAR column, while other batches use 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' text, so the plain CAST to TIMESTAMP fails. 1768543592000 ms decodes to 2026-01-16 06:06:32 UTC, which fits the 06:xx transaction pattern of adjacent batches, so the numeric values can be parsed as UTC epoch milliseconds.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
